correctness.rationale: Every stable cell is an antichain; width at most two makes each cell a singleton or doubleton. Directed equitability and transitivity force every cross-doubleton relation to be a complete order or a perfect matching, with a unique linear class order. The intervening-matching composition lemma gives inductive uniqueness against any strict poset sharing the stable profile. The same argument yields the chordal matching skeleton and elementary abelian automorphism group. Rank-t colour types use C2 counting formulas and stabilization by t<=n-1 gives characteristic rank<=n+1. Independent exhaustive small-poset, orientation-template and sampled automorphism checkers completed successfully; universality rests on the proof.
